page.overview:
Who is Typhoon Devil?

The の|Taifū no Akuma}} is a devil that embodies the concept of typhoons. It is the secondary antagonist of the Bomb Girl arc.

The Typhoon Devil's true form resembles a gigantic humanoid surrounded by a swirling storm of brain matter with the top part of its head exposed, revealing more brain matter which is connected to the storm around it. In Asa Mitaka's flashback, its face resembles that of an old man with a thick mustache.

The Typhoon Devil is subservient and respectful towards Reze and willingly cooperates with her for its own protection.

In a disused bathroom, the Typhoon Devil speaks with a serial killer it has formed a contract with. The man wishes to know why devils are so interested in getting the Chainsaw Devil’s heart. Instead of answering his question, the Typhoon Devil tells him to be wary of the human with Chainsaw's heart, since he has already killed many devils. The serial killer refutes this as the result of those devils’ stupidity and tells a story of how he killed a feared devil hunter in China by taking his wife and daughter hostage and torturing them.
